claim: In the prior project's Micro-Manager configurations, the spinning-disk unit is reached as Hub, Filter_Red, Filter_Blue, Dichroic, Shutter, Bright Field and Port. No device there reports or sets the disk's rotation, so the disk period cannot be read from Micro-Manager with those configurations.
validity_conditions: Ruled TRANSFER, passed 10.3 rule 1 (E3, the device list of that project's configurations as of 2026-09-07). Slot: A1 -- csuw1_disk_speed_exposure_constraint requires an exposure to be an integer multiple of the disk period, and this says no device supplies the period through that route; it bears directly on the `disk_period` gap, asked for from three questions. Scope: those configurations and that adapter version. A different device adapter or configuration could expose the speed, and would falsify this for that configuration. Delivered as item `mm_exposes_no_disk_speed` of microscope_agent/findings/microscope-20260924-3-20260924.json at a5e7647 (card 044); the source was opened at fbedef0 and its sha256 matched before this was ruled.
